verdict.rationale: Idempotent retries are a fair question for a payments REST API, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents idempotency keys, request-ID headers, or safe-retry semantics for PayPal's APIs. The REST, checkout, webhooks and agent-toolkit docs cover other capabilities only.

support.subject: As a developer, I can safely retry any API request using idempotency keys so network failures never create duplicate charges
